newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stora sets up fine paper unit in Latvia.
newsitem.headline: Stora sets up fine paper unit in Latvia.

text.p: Swedish forestry group Stora on Tuesday said it was establishing a wholesale fine papers operation in Riga, Latvia, called Stora Papirs SA.
The company said this was part of Stora's efforts to establish wholesale operations in Eastern Europe.
"Currently work is in progress to establish the business and operations are scheduled to commence formally in January 1997," Stora said in a statement.
Gundega Sproge has been appointed general manager.

Stora said the Latvian operation would have the same focus as Stora Merchant's fine papers wholesale company in Estonia, Stora Paberi AS, namely to conduct inventory, sales, and distribution operations in the local market through its own organisation.
